# kwwk-computer-use-core in Filo

The macOS Accessibility layer behind Filo's computer use, copied
from https://github.com/EYHN/kwwk-computer-use-core at commit eddd9e5475095de58bcb81cafbad79d1f5c5495d (MIT, see
LICENSE). Only `Sources` is kept; its tests and scripts stay upstream. `../Sources/FiloComputerUse` is Filo's bridge
over it, which the runner talks to.

Changes from upstream: none. Keep it that way where possible, and note any change here.
